  <div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content><h4 style="text-align:center;white-space:pre-wrap;"><strong><br>All of the action, none of the stress</strong></h4><p style="text-align:justify;white-space: normal !important;white-space:pre-wrap;" class="">Our island base is positioned in the perfect spot for the ultimate kiting and wing foiling holiday. We are the only accommodation provider on the island that offer all day inclusive boat support for our guests. When you stay in one of our three beach front bungalows you can literally roll out of bed and be in the water sailing in less than 5 minutes. We also offer private and shared rooms a short walk up the hill in our ‘Mango Lodges’ that have a killer view of all the action. </p><p style="text-align:justify;white-space: normal !important;white-space:pre-wrap;" class="">What’s even better is that we organise everything for you as part of your stay package, including delicious nutritious food, arrival and departure transport to and from the island, daily boat support, coaching sessions,  and more!</p></div>

      <div data-fluid-engine="true"><style></style><div class="fluid-engine fe-6678fbd6a870e70b41667008"><div class="fe-block fe-block-d9e989fee9296fcad3ad"><div class="sqs-block website-component-block sqs-block-website-component sqs-block-html html-block" data-block-css="[&quot;https://definitions.sqspcdn.com/website-component-definition/static-assets/website.components.html/98e6c10a-0593-47e4-823a-64feae11ea07_974/website.components.html.styles.css&quot;]" data-block-scripts="[&quot;https://definitions.sqspcdn.com/website-component-definition/static-assets/website.components.html/98e6c10a-0593-47e4-823a-64feae11ea07_974/website.components.html.visitor.js&quot;]" data-block-type="1337" data-definition-name="website.components.html" data-sqsp-block="text" data-website-component-id="d9e989fee9296fcad3ad" id="block-d9e989fee9296fcad3ad"><div class="sqs-block-content"><div class="sqs-text-block-container">
  <div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content><h4 style="white-space:pre-wrap;"><strong>Your stay includes</strong></h4><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Our week long, all inclusive packages start from $2595 AUD for our adult wind sports participants. Non-kiters/foilers get 30% off, teens aged 12-17y/o get 50% off, and kids under 12 are staying for free!<br></p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Our all inclusive weeks include:</p><ul data-rte-list="default"><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;"><strong>Beautiful island setting and hosting by knowledgeable wind sports enthusiasts</strong></p></li><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;"><strong>Transfers:</strong> To and from Nadi Airport to our spot (van + 20min boat ride) on your Saturday arrival/departure dates. Private transfers at an extra charge are necessary for odd date / time requests and for additional trips to the mainland.</p></li><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;"><strong>Accommodation:</strong> 7 nights lodging, right on the windy beach, where you can be on the water within minutes!</p></li><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;"><strong>Dedicated Boat Support:</strong> Daily boat trips upwind to glassy smooth waters, unlimited downwinders and fun missions every day. Snorkelling trips to outer reefs on non windy days.</p></li><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;"><strong>Coaching / Lessons are available as an extra</strong>, and these include structured sessions plus the boat following riders during sessions providing on the the spot instruction (applies to Wingfoiling and Kitesurfing).</p></li><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;"><strong>Food:</strong> Daily breakfast, lunch, dinner at our communal table, tea / coffee, fruit &amp; snacks during the day. Meals are predominately vegan/vegetarian with a focus on healthy seasonal local whole foods.</p></li><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;"><strong>Alternative water sports:</strong> Unlimited access to Kayak/SUP/Snorkelling gear, island walks. Scuba diving to the world famous Vatu-i-Ra / Bligh Water reef can be organised as an extra with our diver partners.</p></li><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;"><strong>Hassle-free arrangements for your gear:</strong> Bring all of the boards you like! Our transfer vans/boats can cater for all of your toys; leave gear in our protected, safe beach front “toy racks” in between sessions.</p></li></ul><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;"><strong>*</strong>Not Included: Kite/Wing Gear hire, Lessons / Skills clinics, Alcohol &amp; Bottles Soft Drinks, Scuba diving, Flights, Travel Insurance, and your other expenses. </p></div>

  <div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content><h4 style="text-align:center;white-space:pre-wrap;"><strong><br>Beachfront Bures</strong></h4><p style="text-align:justify;white-space: normal !important;white-space:pre-wrap;" class="">The Lodge has three beach front bures that are just a few steps away from the beach front. This is the ultimate spot for watching the sun rise and feeling the wind pick up and come through the open aired room. </div></div></div><div class="fe-block fe-block-16f572b12768989bce24"><div class="sqs-block website-component-block sqs-block-website-component sqs-block-html html-block" data-block-css="[&quot;https://definitions.sqspcdn.com/website-component-definition/static-assets/website.components.html/98e6c10a-0593-47e4-823a-64feae11ea07_974/website.components.html.styles.css&quot;]" data-block-scripts="[&quot;https://definitions.sqspcdn.com/website-component-definition/static-assets/website.components.html/98e6c10a-0593-47e4-823a-64feae11ea07_974/website.components.html.visitor.js&quot;]" data-block-type="1337" data-definition-name="website.components.html" data-sqsp-block="text" data-website-component-id="16f572b12768989bce24" id="block-16f572b12768989bce24"><div class="sqs-block-content"><div class="sqs-text-block-container">
  <div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content><p class="" data-rte-preserve-empty="true" style="white-space:pre-wrap;"></p><ul data-rte-list="default"><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Wake up with the stunning sunrise right out your front window and enjoy a morning stretch before a day of action.</p></li><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Expect coffee/tea around 7.30am, followed by breakfast around 8.00am.</p></li><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">During breakfast, you have a ‘skippers meeting’ where you look at the wind and tides for the day.</p></li><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Usually, you’ll be out on the water for your first session between 9.30-10.30am, depending on the wind and tide.</p></li><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">The trip is yours to customise. You and your group can choose to stay on the water anywhere from 2-5h at a time! There are always snacks and drinks on the safety boat for anyone needing a break while you are out there.</p></li><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Once you get back, a delicious lunch is ready for you and you can relax in the hammocks to recover for the afternoon.</p></li><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Depending on what time you get back from the morning riding, you can get back on the water anytime between 2-4pm for an afternoon session when you can foil or kite while watching a magical sunset.</p></li><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">The day finishes with a tasty and well earned supper around 7pm with a debrief of the day’s adventures and cold drinks / beers if you choose to indulge.</p></li></ul></div>

  <div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content><h4 style="white-space:pre-wrap;"><strong>Food </strong></h4><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">We provide daily breakfast, lunch, dinner at our communal table, with tea / coffee, fruit &amp; snacks availble all day.</p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Meals are mostly vegan/vegetarian with a focus on healthy seasonal whole foods plus locally caught fish.</p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">As we are in a somewhat remote location, please let us know of your dietary requirements at the time of booking - we will do our best to accommodate your request but we do need time to plan for it. If you use a special food or supplements, it is best to bring it along with you, as it may not be available in Fiji.</p></div>

      <div data-fluid-engine="true"><style></style><div class="fluid-engine fe-6678fe5f53c06f39994ebb8b"><div class="fe-block fe-block-323b70a698f0fbc786d8"><div class="sqs-block website-component-block sqs-block-website-component sqs-block-html html-block" data-block-css="[&quot;https://definitions.sqspcdn.com/website-component-definition/static-assets/website.components.html/98e6c10a-0593-47e4-823a-64feae11ea07_974/website.components.html.styles.css&quot;]" data-block-scripts="[&quot;https://definitions.sqspcdn.com/website-component-definition/static-assets/website.components.html/98e6c10a-0593-47e4-823a-64feae11ea07_974/website.components.html.visitor.js&quot;]" data-block-type="1337" data-definition-name="website.components.html" data-sqsp-block="text" data-website-component-id="323b70a698f0fbc786d8" id="block-323b70a698f0fbc786d8"><div class="sqs-block-content"><div class="sqs-text-block-container">
  <div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content><h4 style="white-space:pre-wrap;"><strong>Communal Vibes</strong></h4><p style="text-align:justify;white-space: normal !important;white-space:pre-wrap;" class="">Our camp has a community feel with daily debriefs and shared meals in the large communal area. There is plenty of room to spread out with three dining areas. You can also choose to have your meals in your bure or up at your lodge if you are looking for more of a quiet time.&nbsp;</p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Inside of the shared living room you will find maps of the local area, a book swap, some retro wind sports gear and a screen+projector setup! There is a large chill out area under the lush coconut trees that frame the beach front with hammocks, perfect for relaxing with a book and a coconut! </p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Being family run and also the home of owners Warren and Masha, you will also get a great insight into their life off-the-grid on the island and the backyard projects that they get up to in this slice of paradise. </p></div>
